entries.56ef25c282f9fdf6: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥13,566 million, down 1.8% from the previous fiscal year. Revenue was ¥8,671 million in the automatic door business, ¥4,038 million in the fittings business and ¥856 million in other. The main reasons for the revenue decline were that many projects with long construction periods did not become revenue in the current period, and a reactionary decline from large projects.

Net sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥4,038 million.

entries.9badee7ebe990ba1: Aiming to achieve its long-term management vision 'Vision 2030' and its three-year medium-term management plan, the company says it will strengthen selective order-taking for new projects to focus on highly profitable projects, and in the stock market, which is its earnings base, it will work to expand renewal orders and raise its maintenance contract ratio. In the stock market, the company also plans to enter the entrance-area renovation business in earnest, and to strengthen its contact with automatic door users by providing the 'Customer My Page' platform, which allows access to information on the automatic doors that customers use.
